pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped, tan-colored polygons with crenellated or lobed edges. Spatial area is relatively consistent across the mid-flank with a transition to smaller, more fragmented geometries near the ventral and posterior margins. Pixel gradients at edges are soft due to high exposure.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a multi-nodal lattice. Junction nodes primarily feature tri-radiate intersections. Pixel thickness of the corridors remains relatively uniform across the primary flank region.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent, localized tuft of long, dark, curvilinear terminal hairs situated on the sacral/lumbar region of the dorsal midline, contrasting significantly with the surrounding short-hair pelage.
